title: LLMs are not fancy autocomplete
description: Saying LLMs are just fancy autocomplete is like saying humans are just fancy baby makers. Both technically true, both completely miss the point. In the pursuit of making babies humans set foot on the moon and built the standard model of particle physics. In the pursuit of predicting the next word LLMs solved 100 year old math problems and mapped nearly every protein known to man. The simple output metric is not the story. The algorithm optimizing for it is, and it keeps getting more complex.
